disclaimer: Synthetic demonstration form, not an official bank document.

what_to_enter.en: Enter your full legal name as printed on the identity document the form asks for.
what_to_enter.hi: Jo pehchan patra form maangta hai, usi par chhapa poora kanooni naam likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Form keluva gurutina dakhalealli iruva poorna kanoonu hesaranu baredi.

why_needed.en: The form uses this to identify the applicant.
why_needed.hi: Form aavedak ki pehchan ke liye yeh naam maangta hai.

what_to_enter.en: Enter your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.
what_to_enter.hi: Apni janm tithi DD/MM/YYYY praroop mein likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Nimma janma dinankavannu DD/MM/YYYY svaroopadalli baredi.

why_needed.en: The bank uses this as part of customer identification on this demo form.
why_needed.hi: Yeh demo form par pehchan ke liye janm tithi maangi gayi hai.
why_needed.kn: Ee demo formnalli gurutige janma dinanka kelalagide.

what_to_enter.en: Enter your current occupation or write Student, Homemaker, or Retired if that applies.
what_to_enter.hi: Apna vartaman vyavsay likhen, ya Student / Homemaker / Retired likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Nimma igina vrttiyannu baredi, athava Student / Homemaker / Retired baredi.

why_needed.en: The form records how the applicant earns a living.
why_needed.hi: Form aavedak ke vyavsay ka record rakhta hai.

what_to_enter.en: Enter the full name of the person you want to name as nominee, if the form asks for one.
what_to_enter.hi: Yadi form maange to nominee ke roop mein jis vyakti ka naam dena chahte hain, unka poora naam likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Form kelidare nominee aagi hesaru needabekada vyaktiya poorna hesaranu baredi.

why_needed.en: A nominee is the person named to receive proceeds if the account holder dies. This is general guidance, not legal advice.
why_needed.hi: Nominee vah vyakti hai jiska naam aap aapatkal ke liye dete hain. Yeh kanooni salah nahi hai.
why_needed.kn: Nominee endare khateya malika illadiddare hesaru kottiruva vyakti. Idu kanoonu salahe alla.

what_to_enter.en: Mark the account type printed on the form, such as Savings or Current.
what_to_enter.hi: Form par chhape Savings ya Current account type ko chinhit karen.
what_to_enter.kn: Formnalli iruva Savings athava Current khateya prakara gurutisi.

why_needed.en: The demo bank groups applications by account type.
why_needed.hi: Demo bank account prakar se aavedan jodta hai.
why_needed.kn: Demo bank khateya prakara arjigala gumpumaaduttade.

what_to_enter.en: Enter the full postal address the form asks for, including house number and locality.
what_to_enter.hi: Ghar sankhya aur ilake ke saath poora daak pata likhen.
what_to_enter.kn: Mane sankhye mattu pradesha sahita poornadaak vilasavannu baredi.

why_needed.en: The bank uses a postal address for this demo application.
why_needed.hi: Yeh demo aavedan ke liye daak pata maanga gaya hai.
why_needed.kn: Ee demo arjige daak vilasa beku.

what_to_enter.en: Leave this blank in FormSathi. Sign the official paper form by hand.
what_to_enter.hi: Yahan FormSathi mein kuch na likhen. Asli form par haath se hastakshar karen.
what_to_enter.kn: FormSathiyalli idannu khali bidi. Adhikrita formnalli kaiyinda sahi maadi.

why_needed.en: A signature confirms the applicant reviewed the official form.
why_needed.hi: Hastakshar se aavedak form padhkar sahmat hota hai.
